name: windows11-manager
description: Skills for windows11-manager: set it up on a Windows machine and register projects for claude-wt terminal profiles.

interface.shortDescription: Set up windows11-manager and its claude-wt projects
interface.longDescription: Two skills for the windows11-manager window manager: setup installs the node part and the tray app on a Windows machine and writes a first config; project-add registers a project in claudeWt.projects so its Claude Code sessions open in their own Windows Terminal profile.
defaultPrompt: Set up windows11-manager on this machine.
